item.description: ### Fixed - **An OpenCode subagent asking for permission now shows NEEDS YOU.** When a subagent inside an OpenCode session stopped to ask for approval or ask a question, the session kept saying "running" and no alert reached your phone. It now shows NEEDS YOU and sends the alert, and stays that way until every waiting subagent has been answered. - **Answering in OpenCode itself clears NEEDS YOU straight away.** If Perch handed a permission prompt back to OpenCode and you answered it there, the session stayed at NEEDS YOU until the approved command finished. It now clears as soon as you answer. Restart any OpenCode session that was already open to pick this up.
